Customer confirmed availability for tomorrow at 5:00 PM. Rep confirmed: 'I'll meet you there tomorrow. 5:00 PM, okay, awesome.'

top_strength: Joanna gathered comprehensive logistics details efficiently — addresses, property types, square footage, room count, oversized/fragile items, garage and patio items, and TVs — and cleanly routed the call to a virtual walkthrough for a move that exceeds the 1800 sq ft threshold.
coaching_note: Step 2 (Their Concerns) was completely skipped — Joanna never asked the two-concerns question or any open-ended probe about what worries the customer, moving directly into logistics verification instead; this is the first moment to anchor to what matters to the customer and should come before probing for details.
